from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,os,signal
repo=Path('/Users/steventran/jobpipe');base='70b94b474c4a6a9e71e5c5d1af131a3098bec23c'
src=repo/'jobctl.py';test=repo/'tests/test_autopilot_blocked_job_fairness.py'
def git(*a):return subprocess.run(['git',*a],cwd=repo,text=True,capture_output=True,check=True).stdout.strip()
if git('rev-parse','HEAD')!=base or git('rev-parse','origin/main')!=base:raise SystemExit('AUTHORITY_CHANGED')
if git('status','--porcelain','--','jobctl.py') or test.exists():raise SystemExit('TARGET_DIRTY_OR_EXISTS')
s=src.read_text()
old='''    autopilot_parser.add_argument("--continue-on-user", action="store_true")'''
new='''    # Autonomous queue processing must not let a blocked application starve others.
    # Standalone apply-csv retains its conservative stop-on-user default.
    autopilot_parser.add_argument(
        "--continue-on-user", dest="continue_on_user", action="store_true", default=True
    )
    autopilot_parser.add_argument(
        "--stop-on-user", dest="continue_on_user", action="store_false"
    )'''
if s.count(old)!=1:raise SystemExit('PARSER_CHANGED')
src.write_text(s.replace(old,new,1))
test.write_text('''"""Autopilot fairness: blocked jobs do not starve unrelated jobs by default."""
from jobctl import build_parser

def test_autopilot_continues_past_blocked_jobs_by_default():
    args=build_parser().parse_args(["autopilot"])
    assert args.continue_on_user is True
    assert args.submit is False

def test_autopilot_explicit_stop_on_user():
    args=build_parser().parse_args(["autopilot","--stop-on-user"])
    assert args.continue_on_user is False
    assert args.submit is False

def test_autopilot_explicit_continue():
    args=build_parser().parse_args(["autopilot","--continue-on-user"])
    assert args.continue_on_user is True

def test_standalone_apply_csv_retains_stop_on_user_default():
    args=build_parser().parse_args(["apply-csv"])
    assert args.continue_on_user is False
    assert args.submit is False
''')
def run(cmd,timeout):
 p=subprocess.Popen(cmd,cwd=repo,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True,start_new_session=True)
 try:o,e=p.communicate(timeout=timeout)
 except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
  os.killpg(p.pid,signal.SIGKILL);raise SystemExit('TEST_TIMEOUT')
 print('RESULT',p.returncode,o[-3500:],e[-1200:],flush=True)
 if p.returncode:raise SystemExit('TEST_FAILURE')
run([str(repo/'.venv/bin/python'),'-m','pytest','-q','tests/test_autopilot_blocked_job_fairness.py'],110)
run([str(repo/'.venv/bin/python'),'-m','pytest','-q','tests/test_jobctl_review_metrics_latest.py','tests/test_jobctl_ats_fixture_check.py'],110)
subprocess.run(['git','add','--','jobctl.py','tests/test_autopilot_blocked_job_fairness.py'],cwd=repo,check=True)
subprocess.run(['git','commit','-m','feat: continue autopilot queue past blocked applications by default'],cwd=repo,check=True)
subprocess.run(['git','push','origin','main'],cwd=repo,check=True,timeout=90)
print('VERIFIED_PUSH',git('rev-parse','HEAD'),flush=True)
